stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 no-borrowing/cash-only hidden slot was only partially covered through a vague catch-all question rather than an explicit confirmation.

summary: The agent clarified several boundary details but did not explicitly recover the no-borrowing/cash-only constraint; it stopped with this P1 slot unresolved and relied on a volunteered answer.
